name: very_short_greeting
description: A new customer sends only the word 'Hi'. Tests that the AI handles an extremely minimal greeting by responding warmly and proactively asking what the customer needs.

expected_behaviors.description: At least one assistant reply expected
Reply should return a warm greeting
Reply should proactively ask what the customer is looking for

forbidden_patterns.description: No pricing or quotes in the greeting response

notes: With only a one-word greeting, the AI must carry the conversation forward. It should greet warmly and immediately ask what the customer needs (material type, board size, quantity). It should not call any tools or attempt to quote since there is zero product information.
